description: The office reads as a diagnostic wireframe rather than a believable workspace.
evidence: Owner visual review of the six S2B baselines; S2C images preserve the same schematic room shell.
recommended_bounded_correction: S2E may refine room depth, objects, and spatial hierarchy while keeping ATS state mapping unchanged.

description: The active worker is labelled mainly by a short role code; human-readable identity is weak.
evidence: The active S2B baseline shows COM beside the avatar while the full task and worker IDs are in the console/HUD.
recommended_bounded_correction: S2E may add a legible identity treatment that stays bound to the ATS assigned-agent ID.

description: Movement and destination are not perceptually represented in the static office.
evidence: The current scene shows an assigned worker at a desk but no visible travel path or destination narrative.
recommended_bounded_correction: S2E may animate only ATS-supported location changes with a visible destination cue.

description: Failure, reconciliation, and completion remain heavily dependent on text labels and color.
evidence: Each baseline has a distinct written state and color, but little additional object or workflow metaphor.
recommended_bounded_correction: S2E may introduce distinct, ATS-bound work-item shapes or room treatments without hiding the text label.

description: The active marker and nearby avatar label feel cramped at desktop size.
evidence: The active S2B and S2C screenshots place the state marker close to the COM avatar label.
recommended_bounded_correction: S2E may refine local spacing after preserving the S2C bounds and overlap checks.

description: The holding state is truthful but its office metaphor is minimal.
evidence: The waiting baseline shows the dispatch zone and WAITING_FOR_CAPABILITY label with no pickup avatar.
recommended_bounded_correction: S2E may add a clear holding object or queue metaphor while preserving the no-pickup boundary.
